notes.title: We're launching a Kickstarter campaign!
notes.content:
Hello gamers!

We're happy to announce that we started a Kickstarter campaign for our game Leshy.
We're very proud of the game and its reception so far but being a small studio
with a strict budget limits us, which essentially means to cut out things that we want to deliver.
As passionate gamers, our top priority is to create a delightful and immersive experience.
That's why we decided to open a way for you to help us to achieve this goal and
get some nice rewards related to the game at the same time.

The campaign is available here

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40881607/b80edc83cc3fc7cbae1e07a469b65f6906e74b1c.png

Among the exclusive rewards are:
- Name for one of the enemies in the game
- Metal poster
- Slavic amulets
- Limited game copy

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40881607/9dff24c8fcd9a345544a8992e748a009a6869aeb.png

Thank you for your support!

Kind regards,
Glivi Games team.
